identity.name: Variational Omni Alphabet Inc. Class A Perp

about.description: GOOGL is a single-stock perpetual on Variational tracking Alphabet Inc. Class A. Alphabet Inc. Class A is the parent holding company of Google, YouTube, Android, and Waymo (Nasdaq: GOOGL). The market is cash-settled with hourly funding, no shareholder rights, and no dividend rights in the underlying.
